3762
# This is the test-only harness change that lands before the engine changes it checks, so it adds the oracle and its tests together.
# The device sim test-support code (world/intents.rs, world/deletes.rs, world/mod.rs) records each user's intents and judges every device and the server against them: a write, rename, move or delete a user made stays until another user's change replaces it.
# It also runs the revived-delete check on the commits that carried each change, apart from the intent oracle, so a delete brought back by a commit its user never saw is caught without the touch ledger.
# The schedule tests under core/sim/tests/devices/ pin each oracle rule on both sides: a schedule the engine gets right stays green, and each saved battery case the engine still gets wrong is an exact recorded red (devices-oracle-reds.tsv, expect_red with the exact message).
# The devices properties can't stand in for them: they draw schedules at random, so one rule's false positive or false negative is one case among thousands, and the oracle must be shown to accept the legitimate changes (restores, rollbacks, conflict copies, other devices' renames and moves) before it can judge the engine.
# Tests that ran a schedule another test already runs were removed or merged before this count.
